result.title: Directing to Diversify: Multi-Directional Search for Automatic Heuristic Design
result.comment: 46 pages, 9 figures, 19 tables. The main paper, including references, is 13 pages; appendices are included
result.summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong potential to automate heuristic design for NP-hard combinatorial optimization (CO) tasks without human intervention. Recent methods predominantly rely on evolutionary computation (EC) frameworks, where heuristic diversification is mainly induced through EC-like operators or downstream selection, while the direction of heuristic transformation remains largely unharnessed. In this paper, we propose a multi-directional Perturbation-Rewrite Search (PRS) framework for automatic heuristic design that factorizes heuristic transformation through directional search primitives at the generation level. Specifically, PRS operates on heuristic ideas through three complementary directions: expansion toward richer and more expressive designs, compression toward simpler and less specialized designs, and steering for fine-grained refinement, together enabling broader and more sustained exploration of diverse regions in the heuristic design space. PRS further organizes candidate exploration within a breadth-first search-based process with adaptive operator control, which ensures thorough candidate utilization and sustained exploration, and maintains strong search dynamics while preventing premature convergence. Extensive empirical results across diverse CO tasks show that PRS consistently discovers high-quality heuristics, demonstrating the effectiveness and generality of explicitly directional exploration design.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 PRS 框架，让 LLM 从扩展、压缩、精修三个互补方向对启发式想法做扰动—重写，并结合广度优先搜索与自适应算子控制，为 NP-hard 组合优化任务自动设计多样化启发式。
AI.relevance_reason: 其方向化扰动算子与自适应 BFS 控制可能可供核查作为 latent 推理轨迹的候选多样化探索与过早收敛/停止判定线索，但工作面向外部程序式启发式搜索，缺乏视觉与内部状态证据。
